subtask: The product claims: (1) relay cannot lie, (2) all clients derive identical membership, (3) signed work is permanent, (4) deleting events removes all copies. Using NIP-01, NIP-09, and NIP-11 only: For each claim, determine if it's a normative MUST/SHOULD requirement, an optional MAY behavior, or a false premise. Distinguish cryptographic authenticity (signature verification per NIP-01) from availability (relay storage choice) and freshness (event ordering semantics). Explain why NIP-09 deletion is NOT binding across relays. Propose three concrete safeguards clients should implement.
